Sprint S1 remains active because the remaining work is evidence/rollout closure rather than core code repair.

A clean `sn run --flush -c 10 -t 20` completed with `no_eligible_work` after 8m 13s at $9.7013 / $10.00, enriching 54 names, reviewing 73, regenerating 68, and lifting docs-accepted coverage from 154 to 215 while keeping the SN graph suite green.

Sprint S2 launched after a full live-plan review. The sprint is now active with sn-search-facility leading and sn-structured-fanout queued behind its remaining migration work and the already-landed bootstrap/extraction prerequisites.

June sprint set (S2-S4) retired as superseded; S5 (WEST RC dress rehearsal) started with S6 (stability tail: vocabulary rotation, unit authority, DD-gaps foundation) and S7 (graph-wide integrity) queued behind it. Basis: all five D-release-standard convergence gates measured HOLDS on 2026-07-29.

Sprint order inverted by the lead: stability and correctness before the release. S6 is now active and S5 (WEST RC) follows, entering only on the S6 exit criteria: all five gates re-measured HOLDS at the post-rotation pin with the batch parse-check green. The deletion-ledger invariant pulled forward into S6.
